description: Upload an .ipa, .apk or .aab from this computer to AppForShare and return its install link and store readiness result. An .aab is turned into one APK for testers. Pro and Team also share desktop builds (.dmg, .pkg, zipped .app, .msix, .msixbundle, .appx, .appxbundle, .msi), which testers download from the install page. Optional release notes and a channel (such as beta) whose stable link then opens this build.

channel.description: Put the build into this channel when it is ready (Pro and Team)

notes.description: Release notes shown to testers (Pro and Team)

path.description: Path to the build file (.ipa, .apk, .aab, or a desktop build on Pro and Team)

name: upload_build
title: Upload a build
